confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Penang (George Town) pricing for July 2026; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and hostel anchors are moderately certain, and hotel_3star_2p is the least certain. Cocktail and wine were estimated from the local beer relationship (cocktail about 2.5x beer, wine about 3.2x beer) because direct knowledge is weaker. The FX value comes from search-result snippets attributed to the RBA exchange-rates page; that page itself was not opened.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional Southeast Asian basis, comparable to other mid-sized Malaysian and Southeast Asian heritage tourist cities with hawker food, a moderate hostel market, and alcohol prices elevated by Malaysian excise taxes.
